title: Meet the Resistor Family
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Beginning electronics and resistor selection
description: An interactive five-column infographic comparing fixed resistors, potentiometers, trim pots, photoresistors, and thermistors.

learningObjectives: Explain how fixed, adjustable, light-sensitive, and temperature-sensitive resistance support different circuit functions.

keyQuestions: Which resistor types are adjusted by people and which respond to the environment?
How does the intended use determine resistor type?
commonMisconceptions: All resistor-like components have fixed values.
A potentiometer and trim pot are intended for the same kind of adjustment.
